assertion_analysis.condition_for_failure: Fixture lacks 44 commits beyond base, forty primary imports, or primary content 39; these establish the challenge input rather than production coverage.

Restoring full-history traversal refuses an imported primary commit (negative.log demonstrates it), or records/offers 44 rather than four commits; a wrong promoted endpoint, wrong ledger cardinality or recorded imported commit also fails.
Full-history inference adds imports to the offer; the old counter returns 44 instead of four.

A manifest-echo implementation records the injected primary citation in the extra_primary=True arm, and the old ancestry guard refuses the predecessor-base case; the expected own list excludes that injected input.

Removing the manifest-citation union allows the foreign citation and fails to raise; dropping abbreviation normalization misses the subject-bearing citation; a wrong refusal message, ledger write or removed pointer fails the remaining assertions.

assertion_independence: The matching-input scenario supplies own in its manifest, so its equality alone would pass a manifest-echo implementation; durability relies also on extra_primary=True, which deliberately supplies a different list while retaining own as expectation. The combined assertions do not move with the supplied input and fail that regression.
